svg.title: WarHeatMap — live global conflict intelligence platform
svg.desc: WarHeatMap, a live global conflict intelligence platform, reachable at warheatmap.app. Built on Cloudflare Workers with D1 SQLite, Cloudflare KV, Leaflet.js, the AT Protocol and JavaScript ES2024, released under the MIT licence. The live status shown was measured by HTTP request at 2026-08-27 17:09 ET, not asserted. No traffic, latency or event-count figures appear here because none could be verified.
